summary: Frontend-only re-test of the hero carousel image-loading fix + light regression. The preload fix WORKS technically (no partially-decoded/broken images in the DOM at any point), but the user's reported 'one image loading half only' is NOT a loading bug — the source asset for hero slide 2 (/assets/759ad57b24c38f65.jpeg, key hero_eco) is itself defective: its left ~33% (419 of 1264 px) is a flat blank green band. So the visual half-image is still present on the live homepage. Regression checks (homepage, catalog, admin login/sidebar) all passed.

ui_bugs.issue: Source image /assets/759ad57b24c38f65.jpeg is 1264x848 with the left 419px (~33%) a solid flat pale-green blank band (verified pixel-scan + direct file view + direct URL render). With object-cover on a 1920px viewport this renders as a large empty block on the left of the hero, i.e. the 'half image' the user reported. Preloading cannot fix it.

issues: Left third of the hero is a flat empty green area behind the headline; visually reads as a broken/half-loaded image. Replace the asset with a full-bleed 16:9 image, or crop the blank band and/or use object-position right as a stopgap.

action_items: Replace /assets/759ad57b24c38f65.jpeg (content_data.py IMG['hero_eco']) with a non-defective full-frame image, or crop off the left 419px blank band. Also update the value stored in Mongo site_content if it was persisted/published.
Note: this asset is also referenced from Home.jsx and Seo.jsx (og:image candidate) — fix in one place (IMG map) and verify all usages.
No code change needed in HeroCarousel.jsx — preload + eager/async decoding verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: HeroCarousel preload effect creates new Image() per slide on every `slides` identity change; harmless but could be keyed on a stable slide-id list to avoid refetch churn on parent re-renders.

AnimatePresence mode='sync' briefly mounts a second during the 1s crossfade; that new element momentarily reports complete=false/naturalWidth=0 while at opacity 0. Not user visible, but if a truly cold image is ever added it would flash. Consider rendering both current+next layers persistently instead of remount.

success_rate.frontend: 6/7 checks passed (~86%) — only the defective slide-2 asset fails

rca_of_the_issue: User's 'image loading half only' was misdiagnosed as a decode/loading race. Pixel scan of all 14 bundled assets (PIL, flat-column detection) shows only 759ad57b24c38f65.jpeg has a large uniform blank region: left 419/1264 px (33%). Direct navigation to the asset URL and viewing the file on disk both show the blank left third, proving the file content is defective (likely an incompletely generated image), not a transfer/decode issue. Fix = replace/crop the asset.
